task.title: Harden BFF auth facade beyond stub bearer parser
task.summary_zh: 把 operator-bff 自身的 stub bearer parser 升級為可驗證的 auth facade，對齊 runtime-manager 已完成的 JWT/RBAC/MFA hardened boundary；保留明確 dev/test stub mode 但不能在 production 預設接受任意 bearer token。
acceptance: BFF production/default mode verifies JWT issuer audience expiry and subject before building OperatorIdentity
BFF role and MFA checks reject invalid missing insufficient role and non-MFA high risk operator actions
Legacy colon stub token remains available only behind explicit dev/test permissive env flag
Tests cover valid JWT invalid JWT role denial MFA denial and dev stub compatibility
BFF still propagates auth MFA and idempotency headers to downstream command executor
task.next: Owner finalized approved task: BFF auth facade hardening verified. JWT strict mode enforces issuer/audience/expiry/subject/role/MFA; stub mode isolated to PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_STUB=true; secret-misconfiguration returns 401 without leaking env keys. All 314 BFF tests pass.
review_notes_zh: BFF auth facade hardening 已核對並補一個 reviewer hardening：JWT sub 必填，缺少 JWT secret 時回 401 且不外洩 runtime env key；明確 stub mode、JWT issuer/audience/expiry/role/MFA denial 與 settings/command MFA header path 均符合驗收。驗證：python3 -m pytest services/control-plane/bff/ -q => 314 passed, 32 warnings。

delivery.commit_subject: SVC-BFF-AUTH-FACADE-HARDENING finalize BFF auth facade hardening

handoffs.message: BFF auth facade hardening complete. Changes: (1) main.py _extract_identity_jwt: passes mfa_required=True from PANTHEON_BFF_MFA_REQUIRED env var so MFA enforcement works at the identity layer; maps AUTH_JWT_SECRET_MISSING to 401 to avoid server config leakage. (2) test_settings_contract.py: updated to explicitly use @patch.dict(PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_STUB=true) so contract tests are unambiguous about stub mode. (3) conftest.py: new autouse fixture sets PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_STUB=true as default for all BFF tests unless explicitly overridden. (4) test_bff_auth_facade.py already covers all acceptance criteria (34 tests). All 313 BFF tests pass. Verify: python3 -m pytest services/control-plane/bff/ -q
Review approved. Reviewer added JWT subject hardening and secret-misconfiguration response sanitization; full BFF suite passes (314 passed). Owner should finalize to done.
